text.tspan: Air pollution vs. GDP per capita1700 to 2015
Levels of air pollution, measured as suspended particulate matter (micrograms per cubic meter) vs. GDP per
capita (2011 international-$). Here, data for London and Delhi GDP levels are assumed to be in line with
national average values for the UK and India.
Suspended particulate matter (SPM) (micrograms per cubic meter)
Data source: Fouquet and DPCC (2011); Maddison Project Database and World Bank (2017)
Note: Where data is unavailable, the closest value within 5 years is shown instead.
